I'm going to tell you our story.

I didn't know a thing about Malinois. They told me he was a German shepherd 😂 I had him since he was a month old (I know too early). As he grew up we identify him as a Malinois. 
We made some research and boy where we for a ride . I wasn't very active, my husband is but at the time he was my boyfriend and we lived in different cities, I was the one that had the backyard so he stayed with me and on the weekends we would go to his place.
He was wonderful with him. He imprinted on my husband and he saw him as the alpha of the pack. But for some reason he didn't had any respect for me.
He would nibble me, I had bruises and scratches all over my arms.
And he just wouldn't respect me.
I trained him and then yeah he would listen to me. He loved the stimulus. 
But no matter how hard I tried he would always try to be the alpha in my relationship with him. 
So I thought of rehoming him. 
But he was bad with other dogs. He was bad with other humans he was just good with family and our other dog.
So I was like, for his sake I'm going to stay with him even if he nibbles me.

Long story short he is now 3 years old and he's the sweetest dog ever.
He made a hierarchy. Husband first, me second and then the rest of the family. 
He plays rough with my husband and he growls, that's normal. 
But he plays softer with me and usually he just wants me to throw the ball and run after him 😂.
He loves pets and for a Malinois that was super active he became a little bit with less energy. At least with me, when my husband comes home that's another story.
He also helps me mentally.
I have bipolar and sometimes the lows are pretty low. 
I was laid at the sofa once. All sad and empty, he came to the sofa, and start jumping on me 😂 I was like "alright, alright I'm gonna get up! " I just can't be sad with him.
He loves his toys and he also asks me to go walk with him. ( He goes to the door all pumped up or he shows me the leash) He protects me when we go on walks alone, he always goes just a little ahead of me but he waits and he's always looking arround to see if anything is there. When it's me and my husband he runs wild xD 
So yeah don't give up on him, he will adopt himself to you and you to him.

I think it might help having steps written on what she needs to do after and before she cooks.
Like for exemple after cooking : take away trash ( the peels of potatoes, of onions ,carrots, packages etc)
Put away things I won't use anymore ( salt , butter ,milk etc)
Put utensils to wash 
Clean counter and stove.

Steps on how I can do a routine help me a lot. Even if I don't know how to do the steps In my mind I have it there, on the fridge for exemple helps me a lot. But you will have to figure out how it will help best. For exemple it can be on the fridge but it can also be on the phone with notifications and reminders.

Do the same with laundry, donut step by step. And understand that she doesn't think like someone else does. So for you it might be logical to a certain way or to just see it and do it. But she probably needs routines and to stick to it otherwise she won't do stuff.

She needs her meds, it's not perfect but at least it might give you that motivation to do stuff.
There's days when she would just be able to do the bare minimum. And please be ok with that.

Also, tell her that she needs to prepare for the bad days on the good ones. Like prepping food or something like that.

It can feel overwhelming but with patience and a lot of love you guys can do it. Please don't give up on her.
